fields.name: media_footerVariant
fields.label: Footer layout
fields.description: Variant A: the photo (or video) behind; the logo, copyright and button at the left, the columns and social icons at the right. Variant B: the black-to-teal gradient (no photo); the logo, copyright and privacy policy at the left, the button in the centre, CONNECT (the social links as text) and the columns at the right. The columns and social icons: the Column 1, Column 2 and Social icons tabs.

fields.name: media_backgroundMode
fields.label: Background type
fields.description: Image: the background image. Video: the background video, playing muted on a loop (the background image shows until it plays, and instead of it if it cannot).

fields.name: media_backgroundImage
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Covers the whole footer (with Video: shown until the video plays).

fields.name: media_backgroundImageAlt
fields.label: Background image alt text
fields.description: Leave empty when the image is decoration only. At most 125 characters.

fields.name: media_backgroundVideo
fields.label: Background video
fields.description: An MP4 video from Assets, or its full URL. Used when Background type is Video.

fields.name: brand_logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: The JSW MOTORS wordmark, white.

fields.name: brand_copyright
fields.label: Copyright text
fields.description: Under the logo, e.g. © 2026 JSW Motors  Mumbai, India. At most 60 characters.

fields.name: actions_ctaButton

fields.name: actions_ctaButtonText

fields.name: actions_privacyPolicyText
